reason: It says a payment partner takes a fee on top, but it doesn't say who they are, how much, or when the money lands in my account. I already have a POS and a QR menu, and I'm not putting a second QR on my tables for my staff to explain until I know that.
objection: The per-transaction fee is hidden and I don't know who the payment company is or how many days until I get paid. On my margins, an extra percent on every bill matters more than the 59 lari.
would_change_my_mind: A clear written fee that's lower than my bank terminal, with next-day payout from a bank I know, and it working through my existing QR menu so staff learn nothing new.
